parsed.explanation: No trans-specific material exists in this dossier — no presentation offence, border/ID, facility, custody, or care evidence. The documented harms (enforced same-sex statutes, up to 3 years, life/death under sharia in insurgent and southern-administration areas, armed-group killings, regular prosecutions, total societal taboo, no discrimination protection, no rule of law) are sexuality-law based and therefore only a secondary signal under the rubric. But rule 2 permits the statute-plus-surroundings to serve as a signal in a thin-data state, and here the surroundings are severe: capital punishment at a judge's discretion in some regions, documented extrajudicial killings by armed groups (raw counts without denominators, so magnitude unassessable), impunity, absent recourse, and total public silencing of gender/sexual minorities. Extrapolating structural signals — criminalised moral-law enforcement, religious authority, no protection for gender identity — an outed trans visitor faces serious risk, especially outside government-controlled areas. Placed High Risk, lower end, not severe, because trans-specific targeting is undocumented.
